facts.fact: Pluto TV (owned by Paramount) offers 425+ live channels plus thousands of on-demand movies and TV shows, free to viewers.
facts.quote: Owned by Paramount, Pluto TV offers 425+ live channels and thousands of on-demand movies and TV shows, all completely free to viewers.

facts.fact: Pluto TV reached 80 million monthly active users globally as of early 2023, according to the page.
facts.quote: Pluto TV reached 80 million monthly active users globally as of early 2023, with an estimated 50+ million in the United States.

facts.fact: Pluto TV had an estimated 50+ million monthly active users in the United States as of early 2023, according to the page.
facts.quote: with an estimated 50+ million in the United States.

facts.fact: Adwave states that advertisers can run ads on Pluto TV and 100+ other premium channels starting at $30/day.
facts.quote: you can run ads on Pluto TV and 100+ other premium channels from $30/day

facts.fact: Pluto TV ad breaks appear approximately every 11 minutes, according to the page.
facts.quote: Ad breaks appear approximately every 11 minutes with 2-3 minutes of ads per break.

facts.fact: Adwave states it creates a 30-second commercial automatically from a website URL in about 2 minutes (vendor claim).
facts.quote: with your 30-second commercial created automatically from your website URL in about 2 minutes.

facts.fact: Adwave states that advertisers are live in about 4 minutes, per its own pricing page (vendor claim, differs from the 2-minute commercial creation figure on the same page).
facts.quote: you're live in about 4 minutes with phone, email, and chat support on every plan.

facts.fact: Paramount Direct buying for Pluto TV has a minimum spend of $25,000+ with a typical CPM of $20-30, per the page's cost table.
facts.quote: | Paramount Direct | $25,000+ | $20-30 | National brands, sponsorships |

facts.fact: Paramount Ads Manager (self-serve) has a typical Pluto TV CPM of $15-25, per the page's cost table.
facts.quote: | Paramount Ads Manager (self-serve) | Varies | $15-25 | Mid-size businesses with creative |

facts.fact: Programmatic buying via a DSP has a typical Pluto TV CPM of $15-25, per the page's cost table.
facts.quote: | Programmatic (via DSP) | Varies by DSP | $15-25 | Agencies, automated buying |

facts.fact: Programmatic buying via Adwave has a typical Pluto TV CPM of $15-35 with a $30/day minimum, per the page's cost table.
facts.quote: | Programmatic (via Adwave) | $30/day | $15-35 | Small businesses, local advertisers |

facts.fact: The page states that FAST channels average around a $15 CPM (no source cited).
facts.quote: FAST channels average around $15 CPM, making Pluto TV significantly more affordable

facts.fact: The page cites Netflix at a $37 CPM and Hulu at a $25-40 CPM for comparison.
facts.quote: subscription-based streamers like Netflix ($37 CPM) or Hulu ($25-40 CPM).

facts.fact: According to the page, every $100 spent reaches approximately 4,000 to 6,700 viewers.
facts.quote: For every $100 you spend, you're reaching approximately 4,000 to 6,700 viewers.

facts.fact: The page states that 50% of Pluto TV viewers are between 18 and 34 years old.
facts.quote: 50% of viewers are between 18-34

facts.fact: The page states Pluto TV's audience is approximately 58% male and 42% female.
facts.quote: Approximately 58% male and 42% female.

facts.fact: Paramount launched a self-serve ad platform including Pluto TV in 2025, according to the page.
facts.quote: In 2025, Paramount launched a self-serve ad platform that includes Pluto TV alongside CBS, Paramount+, and other Paramount properties.

facts.fact: Paramount Skydance Corporation was formed in 2025 after the Paramount-Skydance merger, per the page.
facts.quote: As part of the Paramount Skydance Corporation (formed in 2025 after the Paramount-Skydance merger)

facts.fact: The page states that because every Pluto TV viewer watches for free, 100% of the audience sees ads.
facts.quote: because every viewer is watching for free, 100% of the audience sees ads.

facts.fact: Budget minimums for direct buys through Paramount's advertising sales team are typically $25,000 or more.
facts.quote: Budget minimums are typically $25,000+.

facts.fact: Through Adwave, access to Pluto TV inventory starts at $30 per day.
facts.quote: gives you access to Pluto TV inventory alongside 100+ other premium channels, from $30/day.

facts.fact: Adwave states a campaign can go live in about 4 minutes.
facts.quote: Live in about 4 minutes with phone, email, and chat support on every plan.

facts.fact: Adwave's vendor page says most local businesses see meaningful results at $200 to $500 per month (vendor claim, not independently verified).
facts.quote: Most local businesses see meaningful results at $200 to $500 per month.

facts.fact: The vendor page states Pluto TV's CPMs are among the lowest in streaming, at $15 to $25.
facts.quote: Because Pluto TV's CPMs are among the lowest in streaming ($15-25)

facts.fact: Pluto TV offers 425 or more live channels, according to the vendor page.
facts.quote: Pluto TV offers 425+ live channels covering movies, news, sports, comedy

facts.fact: The vendor page says Pluto TV content comes from more than 170 partners.
facts.quote: Content comes from 170+ partners including major studios.

facts.fact: The vendor page claims Tubi has more than 100 million monthly users, a third-party-style comparison figure.
facts.quote: Tubi focuses on an on-demand library (100M+ monthly users)

facts.fact: The vendor page says Tubi runs 4 to 6 minutes of ads per hour, while Pluto TV runs closer to traditional TV ad levels.
facts.quote: Tubi runs 4-6 minutes of ads per hour, while Pluto TV runs more ads per hour (closer to traditional TV levels).

facts.fact: The vendor page states that 100% of Pluto TV's audience sees ads, because the platform is free with no account required.
facts.quote: why 100% of that audience sees ads.

facts.fact: The vendor page says Pluto TV supports geographic targeting down to the ZIP code level.
facts.quote: Pluto TV supports geographic targeting down to the ZIP code level

facts.fact: The vendor page says the audience of Pluto TV's cord-cutters includes many viewers in the 25-54 age range.
facts.quote: its audience of cord-cutters includes many viewers in the 25-54 age range.

facts.fact: The vendor page states that Pluto TV ads are non-skippable video ads.
facts.quote: You get the same non-skippable video ads in the same channels that national brands use.

facts.fact: Adwave states its AI creates a 30-second commercial from a website URL.
facts.quote: AI creates your 30-second commercial from your website URL.

facts.fact: The vendor page says Adwave has no contracts and no creative production costs.
facts.quote: No contracts, no creative production costs, no media buying expertise needed.

facts.fact: In 2025, iSpot launched its 'Outcomes at Scale' attribution solution, with Paramount as the first partner.
facts.quote: In 2025, iSpot launched its "Outcomes at Scale" attribution solution with Paramount as the first partner

facts.fact: Pluto TV's ad delivery confirmation is provided at the household and device level, per the vendor page.
facts.quote: CTV advertising on Pluto TV provides ad delivery confirmation at the household and device level.

facts.fact: Through Paramount's Ads Manager self-serve platform, Pluto TV is open to mid-size businesses.
facts.quote: Paramount's self-serve platform gives mid-size businesses access to Pluto TV and other Paramount properties.
